candidates.structural_interaction: Warmth amplifying warmth — illumination running without containment
candidates.k2_overview: Your Fire moves as the Twin: a flame that burns on its own fuel and stands level with every other light. You warm a gathering without needing to lead it, and you bristle when anyone tries to carry you. Two torches burn brighter side by side. That is your theory of company, and mostly it works.
candidates.k2_functional: Your energy burns bright and social: fed by activity, drained by standing in another’s shadow.

k2_domain_readings.Peers: Your peers are fellow fires: vivid friends, loud tables, mutual sparks. The heat of comparison can flare into rivalry fast, so choose companions who celebrate blaze rather than compete for oxygen.
k2_domain_readings.Independence: Fire independence is your own hearth: warmth that no one can dim by leaving. Build a life that stays lit in an empty house, and company becomes a pleasure instead of a fuel line.
k2_domain_readings.Self-reliance: You reignite yourself after setbacks that extinguish others, usually overnight. The skill to learn is banking coals: resting without calling it defeat, so the relight costs less each time.
